sv.title: Elbolag har fått största sanktionsavgiften hittills för brister i säkerhetsskyddet
sv.summary: Flera verksamheter som är viktiga för Sveriges säkerhet har haft brister i säkerhetsskyddet mot exempelvis spionage och sabotage som bedömts så allvarliga att de fått betala miljonbelopp i så kallad sanktionsavgift, det visar Ekots granskning.

en.title: Electricity company receives largest sanction fee so far for security protection shortcomings
en.summary: Several operations important to Sweden's security have had shortcomings in their security protection against, for example, espionage and sabotage, judged serious enough that they have had to pay millions in so-called sanction fees, according to an Ekot investigation.
